instruction: I want to disable the on-screen display notifications in VLC that show up when I adjust volume or skip forward. Please configure VLC Media Player to turn off OSD notifications.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC's OSD notification settings cannot be automatically verified. Validation would require triggering playback events and capturing visual OSD states which is not supported.
metadata.infeasible_reason: VLC OSD display preferences require visual verification during playback which is not evaluable

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - VLC OSD settings require visual verification during playback
Evaluator uses 'infeasible' function which is semantically appropriate for non-verifiable tasks
While VLC configuration files could be checked, this would only verify config state, not actual OSD behavior
True verification would require triggering playback events and analyzing visual overlays, which is beyond framework capabilities
Infeasible classification is semantically correct and well-justified
